children: Grayscale said Robinhood Chain, BNB Chain and Solana handled most tokenized stock trading last week, with weekly spot volume for the sector peaking near $3 billion in early August. According to BeInCrypto, the note said only about 5% of the tokenized equity market is used in on-chain finance, while value locked in tokenized stocks passed $110 million in late August. Grayscale also said lending is starting to catch up, with holdings inside Kamino and Jupiter growing roughly tenfold in a year.

title: Grayscale Names Robinhood Chain, BNB Chain And Solana As Tokenized Stock Winners
